text:
Maria H.: Quick heads-up — our biweekly train on Thu collides with the UK bank holiday for @Olivia. She was going to run the bridge. Can we stitch coverage and shift the public cutoff earlier by 4h for this one? :calendar:

Raj P.: can you propose the new cutoff times? also need to check CI window and any long-running canaries.

Maria H.: thinking: move cutoff from Thu 12:00 UTC -> Thu 08:00 UTC, branch freeze Wed 20:00 UTC. Canary window right after cutoff (08:15-09:00 UTC). That gives us earlier rollback time for EU teams.

Sam K.: works for me if release-bot can schedule the canary at 08:15. also pls update CHANGELOG PR. which version bump are we doing?

Maria H.: bump to v2.3.1 (patch) — several infra fixes only. CHG PR is #3456, I added a stub entry under "Unreleased" but need one-liners from owners.

Olivia T.: thanks for flagging — I can prep the canary playbook before EOD today, but i'll be offline on Thu. will add notes to the runbook and handoff to Raj. @Raj P. can you be primary on the bridge?

Raj P.: I can do the primary bridge. I'll also reach out to @Dana L. for backup in case I get pulled into ops incidents.

Dana L.: happy to be backup. can someone ping me when the final changelog text lands? i'll quick-verify before cut.

Maria H.: copied checklist below — please ack when done.

```
- Update CHANGELOG (PR #3456) — owners add one-liners
- Bump version in package.json, tag after cut: `git tag -a v2.3.1 -m "release v2.3.1"`
- Freeze main -> Wed 20:00 UTC
- Cutoff -> Thu 08:00 UTC
- Canary -> Thu 08:15-09:00 UTC (release-bot schedule)
- Notify support & oncall 30m before cutoff
- Merge hotfixes only, send PR pings to codeowners
```

Raj P.: acked — i'll schedule the canary with release-bot and post the runbook link. also i'll post an announcement in #general 1h before cutoff.

release-bot: Scheduled canary job: canary-v2.3.1 at 2026-04-09T08:15:00Z (id: canary-7862). Notifications to: @Raj P., @Dana L., #support.

Sam K.: quick note — there are two queued PRs that change feature flags (PRs 3490, 3512). If they land after the freeze we should hold them. please ping codeowners: @frontend-team.

Maria H.: good catch Sam — tagging them now and adding a line in the checklist. everyone please react :thumbsup: if you can cover your item.

Olivia T.: done. added runbook tweaks in the doc. safe travels to EU folks on holiday :)

Raj P.: I'll follow up with an exact timeline tomorrow morning. thanks all.
